headline: Unitil Outlines $1.2B Capital Plan and Rate Base Growth in Q3 Slides
summary: Unitil presented its Q3 slides detailing a $1.2 billion capital plan that drives projected rate base growth of 6.5% to 8.5%.
why: Regulated utility capital expenditure plans provide predictable cash flow and earnings growth visibility for defensive equity investors.

impacts.name: Unitil Corp
impacts.why: Large capital plans expand the rate base on which regulated utilities earn returns.
